checks.detail: 23 glass interfaces at ~4% loss each gives 0.3911 against the measured 0.1953: the 98% -> 19% collapse is compounding, not a bug

checks.detail: H through a V polarizer transmits 6.448e-07 against 0.117654 for V -- an extinction ratio of 5.48e-06 (52.6 dB). Not identically zero: 23 Fresnel interfaces before and after the polarizer rotate the s/p basis, so a little H leaks into the polarizer's eigenstate. That residual is physics, not numerical noise.
